183. Vowel Check in Strings

40

Problem Statement:
Given a number N and an array of N strings,Print yes, if all strings have atleast one vowel in them otherwise print no.
input_spec: The input consists of an integer N (where N <= 1000), followed by N strings.
output_spec: The output is "yes" if all N strings contain at least one vowel, and "no" otherwise.
